preconditions.description: The to_currency parameter must be either 'USD' or 'EUR'.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(value, (int, float)) for value in values_list)
preconditions.description: Each value in the values_list must be a number.

postconditions.description: The length of the result list must be the same as the length of the input list.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(formatted_value, str) for formatted_value in result)
postconditions.description: Each item in the result list must be a string.
Each formatted value must start with either '$' or '€'.
Each formatted value, with commas and periods removed, must represent a valid number.

postconditions.expression: all(float(formatted_value.replace(',', '').replace('$', '').replace('€', '')) == value for value, formatted_value in zip(values_list, result))
postconditions.description: Each formatted value must correctly represent the original value, rounded to two decimal places.
